mechanism.domainTask: Multi-channel whale-call association via agentic program synthesis
mechanism.populationDetail: UCT/MCTS maintains candidate programs as nodes with edit-operation edges; explicit parent-child search tree.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Algorithm and pruned databases appear as post-search corpora; no separately specified in-loop elite archive admission rule.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Tree expansion inserts child programs; held-out pruning and warm-start carryover are later pipeline stages.
mechanism.generationDetail: The selected UCT node is the single editable parent; the paper does not expose enough of the edit prompt/protocol to distinguish broad from localized modification.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Diagnostics and weighted F1 guide subsequent UCT selection and code edits.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: UCT selects one node from the global search tree; Appendix B adds a 0.4-probability branch selecting a debuggable leaf. At regime transitions, the prior-regime best also seeds the next search, but is not shown as an additional simultaneous parent.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Regime-scheduled simulator curriculum plus UCT/warm-start orchestration is not represented by one current taxonomy field.
